title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Job Fair Hall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Job Fair Hall
options.thesis: The homepage is the fair floor: the club's hall at full event scale.
options.viewport: Main-stage banner hero: the club's headline at billboard scale, partner and apply actions as ticket stubs, nav as a wayfinding rail.
options.risk: Reads carnival when the banner type is set timidly.

raised.raise: Stats render as a live counting board that visibly ticks to each number.
One shared stage clock orchestrates every marquee and reveal; no scattered hover effects.
Condensed display caps at collision scale on the main banner.
Type scale jumps footnote-to-billboard between sections.
Display type carries structural mass - headlines as architecture, not decoration.

options.label: The Annual Report
options.lineage: corporate annual reports and MoU prospectuses
options.thesis: The club printed as the document a partner signs against.
options.viewport: A report cover-hero with folio numbers, ruled stat spreads, and a sign-here partner inquiry action.
options.risk: Also the direction most credible-institution designs land on.

options.label: The Fight Card
options.thesis: The club's flagship events collide at poster scale.
options.viewport: BizCase headline colliding across the fold, events stacked as undercard rows.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: event drama and proof carry the page; loses narrowly on the partner offer.
options.risk: Reads aggressive when the versus axis carries the navigation.

options.label: The Layered Craft
options.thesis: Skill-building shown as flat colour layers cut and pasted one over another.
options.viewport: A symmetrical layered roundel carrying the club crest, benefits as pasted layers.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: local folk-craft resonance and the layered-skills metaphor; loses narrowly on corporate credibility.
options.risk: Reads boutique when the corporate proof is demoted.

options.label: The Counting Board
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither partner nor student identifies with laboratory instruments.
options.kept: Visible numeric state - stats as living counts.

options.label: The Algorave Floor
options.case: Fuses poorly: a live-code dance floor says party, not pipeline.
options.kept: One shared clock for all page motion.

options.label: The Hybrid Collage
options.case: Fuses poorly: layered collage muddles the reading order a partner scan needs.
options.kept: Scale jumps from footnote to billboard.

options.label: The Alphabet Storm
options.case: Fuses poorly: type as weather cannot carry the club's factual proof.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a university club site ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other club site by design.
